name: RDS Snapshot Sharing
description: An attacker with rds:ModifyDBSnapshotAttribute adds restore permission for an external account. The attacker's account uses rds:CopyDBSnapshot to copy the snapshot, then restores it to a new DB instance and extracts database contents. This exfiltrates full database data. Unencrypted snapshots are fully readable. Required permission is rds:ModifyDBSnapshotAttribute. The attacker needs rds:CopyDBSnapshot in their account.
